plan.fixture: full limbs (37*i+17*k+9) mod p; exact zero-seed v2 identity
plan.scope: CPU bounded encoder only; standard is a schema tag, no PCS/profile admission or fit
plan.timing: factory, input preparation, complete measured encode, complete query re-encoding and every-output integer validation; includes observation overhead and all per-call setup hashing, sampling, sorting, allocation, initialization, copies and base work; excludes build, launch, argument parsing, JSON serialization and final native drops
plan.generation: performed inside both encode and query timers, never amortized; actual hash blocks and rows are observed, not a separately isolated timing
plan.validation: independent integer sparse evaluator and independently derived dense Circle base; independently assembled BLAKE3 records; every output and query value checked
plan.capacities: actual owned Vec liveness includes output/scratch/base/twiddle/prefix/query overlap; native live adds retained caller input and original encoded output; excludes validator, stack, runtime and allocator bookkeeping
plan.process_memory: per-worker time -l peak RSS includes native and validation buffers, all stack, runtime and allocator retention; controller excluded
plan.stack: exact compiled native/hash frame inventory and explicit recursion counts, separate from inline object sizes and process RSS; not a whole-process stack bound
plan.counters: logical operations: sparse base-limb adds/products, K initialization/copies and Circle transform K operations; twiddle/prefix values recorded separately; no instruction/traffic or complete base-field-operation equivalence is claimed
plan.warmup: release code tests, dense-base fixture check and small receipt smoke in separate processes
